headline: When Should You Consider Replacing Your Windows?
articleBody: Thinking about new windows? It's a bigger decision than just curb appeal, impacting your comfort and energy bills! If you feel drafts near your windows, even when they're closed, that's a pretty clear sign they're not sealing properly anymore, letting your AC or heat escape. You might notice your energy bills are creeping up without a good reason, or perhaps some rooms are always too hot in summer and too cold in winter. Condensation between your window panes, not just on the surface, means the seal has failed, allowing moisture in and reducing insulation effectiveness. Another big indicator is difficulty opening, closing, or locking your windows – they shouldn't stick, jam, or be hard to secure. If you have single-pane windows, especially in older homes, upgrading to modern double-pane options will drastically improve your home's insulation and soundproofing. Finally, visible damage like warped frames, rotting wood, or cracked glass definitely points to replacement. When you're seeing several of these issues, it's probably time to call in a professional like Affordable Home Remodeling. They can help you figure out the best solution for your home in areas like Cerritos or Irvine, ensuring a long-lasting and efficient upgrade.
